overall: Tomorrow (Friday, July 3) in Los Angeles is expected to be a classic early-July marine layer day — mostly cloudy with patchy fog persisting through mid-morning, gradually clearing to partly cloudy skies by afternoon. Southwest winds of 5–15 mph will keep conditions mild and seasonably cool, consistent with a June Gloom/July marine influence pattern. No significant severe weather; the active alerts (Lake Wind Advisory and Air Quality alerts) are for inland/desert areas and do not materially affect coastal LA.
